verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirmed a keyless JSON GET endpoint for Colorado business-entity data that returns HTTP 200 and could be scripted in CI. The SOS also points to its own business-data offering (Intelligence Center), and data.colorado.gov exposes the entity filings. This is read-only data access hosted on the Socrata open-data platform rather than the registry itself, and nothing shows headless filing, renewals or name reservation. missing for 10: programmatic or headless filing and transaction APIs, documented automation or CI guidance, authentication for account actions, and first-party API docs from the registry itself.
